feedback_flag.title: Feedback Flag
feedback_flag.no_flags: Choose Place flag, then right-click a block. Open this menu with /feedbackflag.
feedback_flag.memo_placeholder: Describe this flag's purpose or add a reminder…
feedback_flag.delete_hint: Its existing timeline records will be kept.
feedback_flag.observation_note: Received server block state. Only loaded blocks are observed. Inventories and other block entity data are not recorded.
feedback_flag.press_key: Press a key or mouse button…
feedback_flag.keys_hint: Both shortcuts start unassigned. /feedbackflag opens the menu. Press the placement key, then right-click a block.
feedback_flag.place_hint: Right-click a block to pin a flag. Press the placement key again or use /feedbackflag place to cancel.
feedback_flag.look_at_block: Look at a block within reach first.
feedback_flag.flag_limit: This world has reached the limit of 128 flags.
feedback_flag.load_failed: History could not be loaded. Original file preserved; saving is disabled.
feedback_flag.save_failed: Could not save history. Retrying automatically.
feedback_flag.legacy_event_tick: %s ticks since the first legacy change (old clock)
feedback_flag.mixed_ticks: Receipt order · see each record for its tick
feedback_flag.clear_history_hint: Deletes these records and resets activity counts. Flags, tags, memos and settings stay. After a full reset, the next change is the new zero tick. This cannot be undone.
feedback_flag.display_hint: Click to cycle Flags → Block outlines → Both. Outlines mark the watched one-block coordinates. When flags are hidden, use the menu or crouch and right-click the block with an empty hand to edit.
feedback_flag.tags_hint: Up to 8 tags, 24 characters each. Example: input, circuit A. Stored separately from name and memo; filter the timeline by tag.
feedback_flag.group_hint: Click to expand or collapse changes in this tick. Each color represents one flag.
feedback_flag.individual_hint: Enable or pause all recording for this flag. Changes made while paused are not recorded later.
feedback_flag.watch_blocks_hint: Record block type changes, such as stone → air (removal) or air → block (placement).
feedback_flag.watch_states_hint: Record property changes within the same block, such as lever power, open doors, or crop age.
feedback_flag.clear_filter_hint: Resets all history or this selected flag, regardless of the tag filter.
